To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the role of HR capabilities, and in particular the role of informational capabilities, in diffusing BD PA and driving subsequent performance is significant and should not be overlooked.

(1) Informational and HR capabilities are important in the diffusion of BDPA and in the ensuing organizational performance, and (2) BDPA diffusion is the key mediating variable that explains the relationship between IT deployment and organizational performance, and between HR capabilities and organizational performance.
BDPA diffusion is affected by IT deployment and HR practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the diffusion of BDPA and the subsequent impact on organizational performance.
the diffusion of BDPA in the context of Indian firms, and its impact on firm performance.
the role of IT deployment and organizational HR capabilities in the diffusion of BDPA and its subsequent impact on organizational performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HR capabilities and informational capabilities play a critical role in enabling BDPA diffusion and performance.
BDPA diffusion is a function of both IT deployment and HR, and that this diffusion has a positive relationship with performance.
the more flexible the IT deployment, the better the business BDPA partnership, the better the BDPA alignment, the better the organizational performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BDPA diffusion is not only driven by technology but also by the people who are involved in the process of BDPA diffusion.
BDPA can be a source of sustainable competitive advantage, and the role of human resources and informational capabilities is critical in enabling the diffusion of BDPA.
the more an organization can leverage the capabilities of its people and information, the better its ability to diffuse BDPA and the better its organizational performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the role of BDPA in driving business performance is contingent on the organizational capabilities and HR capabilities, which should be taken into account by practitioners when considering BDPA deployment.
BDPA is not a silver bullet, and that firms need to invest in both the technology and the human capital that will support its effective deployment.
HR is a key enabler for BDPA diffusion and performance, and that the informational capabilities are a critical factor for diffusing BDPA and performance.
